title: Transaction
description: A normalized bank or card transaction read from a CSV export, with the provenance needed to trace it back to its source row. Schema version 0.1.0.

id.description: Deterministic identifier derived from the source file hash and the row number: "tx_" followed by the first 24 hex characters of sha256("<source_sha256>:<row_number>").

date.description: Calendar date of the transaction (ISO 8601, YYYY-MM-DD). No time and no time zone.

amount.description: Signed decimal amount as a string. Money in is positive, money out is negative. At least two fraction digits, no exponent, no thousands separators.

currency.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code, upper case.

description.description: Free-text description from the export. Empty string when the export has none.

merchant.description: Merchant, payee or counterparty exactly as it appears in the export (trimmed), or null.

category.description: Category exactly as supplied by a column in the user's CSV, or null. Never inferred.

account.description: Account label from a CSV column or from the mapping's default account, or null.

source_file.description: File name of the CSV export, relative to the exports folder.

source_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes of the source file, lower-case hex.

row_number.description: 1-based data row number. The header is not counted, so row 1 is the first record after the header.

mapping_id.description: Identifier of the column mapping used to read the row: "map_" followed by the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the mapping's canonical JSON.
